console.allProviders.description: The developer console's provider filter: no filter, every coding agent CLI's events.

console.assistant.description: The developer console's source picker: the Hive Assistant's session as a source. Hive's name stays as it is.

console.bytes.description: The developer console's event detail: the payload's size.

console.cancel.description: The developer console's recording box: closes it without recording.

console.cancelled.defaultMessage: The recording was cancelled: the console stopped watching that source
console.cancelled.description: Why a developer console recording didn't start: meanwhile the window closed, picked another source or started another recording.

console.capturing.description: The developer console's status bar: Hive is capturing the watched source's events.

console.clear.description: The developer console's button: hides the events so far; only later ones show.

console.close.description: The developer console's event detail: closes it. Esc is its key: keep it.

console.dropped.defaultMessage: {n, number} not delivered (too many at once)
console.dropped.description: The developer console's status bar: events that came too fast for the window, so it never got them.

console.emptyRedacted.defaultMessage: Pick a source to watch. Hive captures a source only while this window watches it, and what it captures is redacted: no prompt or reply text, commands, tokens or sign-in details.
console.emptyRedacted.description: The developer console while no source is picked.

console.emptyText.defaultMessage: Pick a source to watch. Hive captures a source only while this window watches it, and what it captures is redacted: no tokens or sign-in details (this window shows prompt, reply and command text while the setting is on).
console.emptyText.description: The developer console while no source is picked, with the setting that shows text on (Settings → Advanced).

console.eventTypes.description: The developer console's row of buttons that show or hide each kind of event (accessible name).

console.events.defaultMessage: {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}{cleared, select, yes { (cleared)} other {}}
console.events.description: The developer console's status bar: how many events it lists; (cleared) when Clear hid the earlier ones.

console.eventsOf.defaultMessage: {shown, number} of {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}}{cleared, select, yes { (cleared)} other {}}
console.eventsOf.description: The developer console's status bar: how many events the search and filters show, of how many; (cleared) when Clear hid the earlier ones.

console.failed.defaultMessage: Recording failed after {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} in {name}: {error}
console.failed.description: The developer console's status bar: a recording to the file {name} stopped as it couldn't be written; {error} says why.

console.fileFull.defaultMessage: The recording file took nothing more
console.fileFull.description: Why a developer console recording failed: writing to its file wrote nothing (the disk may be full).

console.includeText.defaultMessage: Include prompt and reply text in this recording (tokens and sign-ins stay masked)
console.includeText.description: A check box in the developer console's recording box: the recording keeps the prompts', replies' and commands' text; secrets stay hidden.

console.live.description: The developer console's indicator: events show as they come.

console.made.description: The developer console's event detail: the heading of what Hive read from what came in.

console.noMatch.description: The developer console's list: the search and filters hide every event.

console.notCapturing.description: The developer console's status bar: Hive isn't capturing the watched source's events.

console.notWatching.description: The developer console's indicator: no source is picked, so nothing is captured.

console.notWritten.description: The developer console: why a recording failed, when there's no other reason: 'Recording failed after 3 events in <file>: it could not be written'.

console.nothing.description: The developer console's event detail: an empty side (nothing came in, or Hive made nothing of it).

console.outline.description: The developer console's event detail: the payload was too large to keep, so only its shape (fields, sizes) was kept.

console.outlineTip.defaultMessage: Cut down to its outline (too large)
console.outlineTip.description: The developer console: an event's payload was too large to keep, so only its shape (fields, sizes) was kept.

console.pause.description: The developer console's button: the list stops moving (capture goes on).

console.paused.description: The developer console's indicator while paused: the list holds still; {waiting} events came meanwhile (shown on resume).

console.pickSource.description: The developer console's source picker, while it watches none.

console.provider.description: The developer console's filter by coding agent CLI (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot), accessible name.

console.raw.description: The developer console's event detail: the heading of what came in, as it came (from the CLI).

console.record.description: The developer console's recording box (accessible name).

console.recordToFile.description: The developer console's button that opens the recording box: the source's events from now on go to a file.

console.recordWhat.defaultMessage: Record {source} to a file, from now until you stop. Redacted unless you tick text: no prompt or reply text, commands, tokens or sign-ins.
console.recordWhat.description: The developer console's recording box. {source} is the watched agent's name, the Assistant, Hive, or the words 'this source'. 'Tick text' refers to the box below it (include prompt and reply text).

console.recording.defaultMessage: Recording {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} to {name}{withText, select, yes { (with text)} other {}}
console.recording.description: The developer console's status bar while it records: how many events so far, to the file {name}; (with text) when prompt and reply text are kept.

console.redactedStatus.defaultMessage: Redacted: no prompt or reply text, commands, tokens or sign-ins
console.redactedStatus.description: The developer console's status bar: what it hides.

console.refresh.description: The developer console's button that lists the sources (agents, the Assistant, Hive) again.

console.resume.description: The developer console's button: the list moves again, filled in with what came while paused.

console.saved.defaultMessage: Saved {n, plural, one {# event} other {# events}} to {name}{limit, select, yes { (it reached its size limit)} other {}}
console.saved.description: The developer console's status bar: a recording ended, with how many events, in the file {name}; the note when it stopped at its largest size.

console.search.description: The developer console's search box (placeholder). Ctrl+F is its shortcut: keep it.

console.searchLabel.description: The developer console's search box (accessible name).

console.showInFolder.description: The developer console's status bar: shows the recording's file in File Explorer.

console.source.description: The developer console's source picker (accessible name): which agent's session, the Assistant or Hive itself it watches.

console.sourceCount.description: The developer console's source picker: a source ({name}: an agent, the Assistant or Hive) with how many events it has captured.

console.startRecording.description: The developer console's recording box: starts recording the source's events to a file.

console.stopRecording.description: The developer console's button while it records the source's events to a file.

console.thisSource.description: The developer console's recording box, where the watched source's name goes when it isn't known: 'Record this source to a file…'.

console.tooMany.defaultMessage: Too many developer consoles open at once
console.tooMany.description: An error opening a developer console window or starting a recording: Hive already watches for as many as it allows. Closing one helps.

console.unredacted.defaultMessage: Unredacted: this console shows prompt, reply and command text (Settings → Advanced → Developer console: show prompt, reply and command text). Tokens, API keys and sign-in details stay masked.
console.unredacted.description: A warning banner in the developer console while the setting that shows text is on. Settings → Advanced → Developer console: show prompt, reply and command text is where it is: use those translated names. <b> is bold: keep the tags.

console.unredactedStatus.defaultMessage: Unredacted: text shown; tokens and sign-ins masked
console.unredactedStatus.description: The developer console's status bar while the setting that shows text is on.

console.waiting.description: The developer console's list: the source is watched, and nothing has come yet.
